name: CBS - Enquiry Prep

parameters.jsCode:
var B=$('Page Part 1').first().json.p1+$('Page Part 2').first().json.p2+'';
var HTML=(typeof Buffer!=='undefined')?Buffer.from(B,'base64').toString('utf8'):decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(B)));
var s=0;for(var i=0;i<HTML.length;i++){s=(s*31+HTML.charCodeAt(i))%1000000007;}
return [{json:{b:HTML,check:s===715041912?'ok':'mismatch '+s,len:HTML.length}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ job_no: $('Up Link').first().json.job, item_id: $('Up Link').first().json.i, pdf_url: $('Up Link').first().json.u, name: $('Up Link').first().json.n, doc_key: 'Enquiry upload ' + $('Up Link').first().json.i }) }}

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://api.servicem8.com/api_1.0/attachment.json?%24filter=' + encodeURIComponent("related_object_uuid eq '" + ($('EP Job').first().json.uuid || 'none') + "' and active eq 1") }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{p1:''}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ job_no: $('AP Check').first().json.job, mode: $('AP Check').first().json.mode, create: true, by: $('AP Check').first().json.by }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{p2:''}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ related_object: 'job', related_object_uuid: $('MV Check').first().json.uuid, note: $('MV Check').first().json.note }) }}

parameters.jsCode: var c=$('MV Check').first().json;return [{json:{ref:c.ref,moves_json:c.moves_json}}];

parameters.redirectURL: ={{ 'https://old-hub.example/webhook/cbs-jobs' + (function(q){ var k = Object.keys(q || {}); return k.length ? '?' + k.map(function(x){ return encodeURIComponent(x) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(q[x]); }).join('&') : ''; })($json.query) }}
